content: Plannotator (backnotprop, open source): visual annotation of agent plans and code diffs, runs locally, Claude Code plugin, plannotator_submit_plan gate UI (approve / deny-with-annotations / approve-with-notes), markdown file annotation with structured feedback to agent, encrypted share links. markupmarkdown 1.0 (metavert.io): Google-Docs-style comments on real .md files in repo (file stays canonical), comment threads, review states that gate pushes, one-click suggested edits, CI-style doc checks with reusable policies, AI auto-review of every revision via Claude, agents join via MCP server with scoped tokens + bot badges, agents can be standing reviewers, GitHub round-trip (PR or direct commit), realtime sync. Both single-layer English, single-repo scope, no digest/translation layer, no cards, no cross-project contracts.
